chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
It is recommended for the sick person to give to the beggar with his own hand and to ask the beggar to supplicate for him.

key_terms.السَّائِلَ: the beggar; the one asking from others
key_terms.بِيَدِهِ: with his own hand; personally and directly
key_terms.لِلْمَرِيضِ: for the sick person; one afflicted by illness
key_terms.يَدْعُوَ لَهُ: to supplicate for him; to make du'a on his behalf
key_terms.يُسْتَحَبُّ: it is recommended; a meritorious act in religious practice

ai.seo_question: What is recommended for a sick person to do when giving charity?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that it is recommended for an ill person to personally give charity to a beggar and request his du'a. It highlights both the merit of charity and the spiritual benefit of seeking supplication during illness.
